**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction on Tri City National Bank. I checked the appointment (§ 3), fees (§ 8), termination (§ 11), confidentiality/ownership (§ 17), miscellaneous (§ 22) and source code (§ 23) provisions, plus targeted searches for "compete/competing", "shall not engage", "Customer shall not", "exclusive", "restrict", "in-house" and "similar services".

- § 17.2 only confirms we hold no rights in M&I's software — standard IP language, not a covenant restricting our business.
- § 22.14 is the only restrictive covenant: a mutual, Term-limited employee non-solicit, which does not restrict the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build.

This sits at the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so nothing to redline.
